# Overlay { #anylumino.astryx.Overlay }

```python
Overlay(
    children,
    content,
    *,
    show_on='always',
    open=None,
    scrim='dark',
    position='fill',
    align='end',
    **props,
)
```

Render content over a base Astryx surface or media widget.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type              | Description                                                                          | Default    |
|----------|-------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| children | ChildInput        | Base widget displayed beneath the overlay.                                           | _required_ |
| content  | str \| ChildInput | Text or widget rendered inside the overlay scrim.                                    | _required_ |
| show_on  | str               | Visibility trigger: ``"always"``, ``"hover"``, ``"focus"``, or ``"hover-or-focus"``. | `'always'` |
| open     | bool \| None      | Optional visibility override. When omitted, ``show_on`` controls visibility.         | `None`     |
| scrim    | str \| bool       | Dark or light scrim, or ``False`` for no scrim.                                      | `'dark'`   |
| position | str               | Overlay placement: ``"fill"``, ``"bottom"``, or ``"top"``.                           | `'fill'`   |
| align    | str               | Content alignment: ``"start"``, ``"center"``, or ``"end"``.                          | `'end'`    |
| **props  | Any               | Additional JSON-safe Overlay props forwarded to Astryx.                              | `{}`       |

## Astryx Props {.doc-section .doc-section-astryx-props}

``children``, ``content``, ``showOn``, ``isOpen``, ``scrim``, ``position``,
and ``align`` are adapted by the named arguments above. ``**props`` keeps
the wrapper forward-compatible with additional JSON-safe Astryx props.

See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Overlay>.
